scope: W14 Desktop integration construction evidence, not product acceptance
changes: Removed the duplicate ros:workspacePickDirectory IPC registration that prevented Electron boot.
Resolved preload and local host discovery from the Desktop package and repository roots, and used the control host's supported --discovery-file argument when RESEARCHOS_CONTROL_EXE is configured.
Added project/session selection, server snapshots, ordered events, messages, run status, artifact references and hash-checked text preview to the renderer Electron actually loads.
Added read-only attach and settled-run writer takeover. The takeover acknowledgement is followed by session.get to receive the new writer epoch before sending the next message in the same session.
Kept all review and continuation calls on the typed researchos-client/2 IPC bridge; no model operation is invoked by the smoke or fixture.

The Node sequence check uses a controlled in-process host fixture. Its PASS proves Desktop envelope, IPC and state transitions, not production host behavior or independent acceptance.

The host does not implement workspace.diff or session.handoff, so the review surface does not claim a diff or a handoff. Continuation is a settled-run writer takeover followed by a new message, not session.control RESUME.
